anat.lead: A detailed 1:64 wheel is more than one piece of plastic. Hover each component to see how it is built.
anat.tyre_text: The tyre sits on the outside of the wheel and grips the track.
anat.lip_text: The lip and barrel give the wheel its depth and dish.
anat.face_text: The face carries the spoke design and the finish.
anat.disc_text: A separate rotor behind the spokes, so the wheel looks right from every angle.
anat.hub_text: The centre of the wheel, where it meets the axle.
